actions.description: Post a Block Kit notification to Slack when a work item is created in the configured Jira project. chat.postMessage answers HTTP 200 even when it fails, so check $.response.data.ok in the flow log to confirm delivery.

flowVariables.name: slackOk
flowVariables.instruction: true when Slack accepted the message. chat.postMessage returns HTTP 200 with ok=false on failure, so this is the only reliable success signal.

flowVariables.name: slackError
flowVariables.instruction: Slack error code when ok is false, for example channel_not_found, not_in_channel or invalid_auth.

actions.name: Post Work Item Created Message to Slack

conditions.description: Only notify on work item created events
Only notify for work items in the configured Jira project

description: Post a Slack message when a Jira work item is created

flowVariables.name: SPACE
flowVariables.instruction: Jira project key to notify for. Only work items created in this project are posted to Slack.

flowVariables.name: SLACK_CHANNEL
flowVariables.instruction: Target Slack channel. A channel ID such as C01234567 is recommended because it survives channel renames; a name such as #jira-alerts is also accepted. The Slack app must be a member of the channel, or hold the chat:write.public scope.

name: Slack - Notify on Work Item Created
